note: Derived from inference.posterior(n=40000, sigma=0.005, seed=8047, observations=CASE); reproduces case_regions.json (ESS 2893.04, mean [2.6977,1.9865], areas [0.2194,0.8085]); the grid mode may differ from case_regions.json by about 1 cm because the KDE grid bounds are drawn from a resample, so case_regions.json remains authoritative for the published mode. Probability is the weighted fraction of posterior endpoints with |Y|<3.66 m and 0<Z<2.44 m, conditional on airborne crossing; it refers to the ball centre and ignores ball radius and woodwork.
